AINRC Wins Puducherry Bypoll, TVK Leads in Tamil Nadu

The All India N.R. Congress (AINRC) secured a significant victory in the Thattanchavady constituency bypoll in Puducherry, retaining the bastion of N. Rangasamy. In Tamil Nadu, the Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam (TVK) maintained its lead in bypolls.
